Name: Auto Forager - Moss Mania
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#00ffff]Description[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Auto Forager will no longer automatically collect Moss.
Even when walking near moss-covered trees, Auto Forager will ignore the Moss completely.
Moss must be collected manually with a scythe.[/size]

[b][color=#efefef][size=4]Pairs well with:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48359][color=#ff00ff]Tool Hotkeys[/color][/url][/i][/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]This mod was made for Moss Mania. Switch to your scythe anytime with a single button. [u]For controller users especially, it's practically essential.[/u] Now go forage moss to your heart's content. [/size][/color]


[size=4][b][color=#00ffff]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Place the downloaded [/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]config.json [/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]file into the Auto Forager mod folder and overwrite the existing file.
Backing up the original [/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]config.json [/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4]is recommended before replacing it.[/size][/color]


[size=4][b][color=#00ffff]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]You need to download the Auto Forager mod separately.[/size][/color]
